equity.level_reason: Comparisons are across countries, regions and years against surveillance targets; the only SPD is age (<15 years), which defines the NPAFP rate denominator.

level_alternative.reason: A limitation notes that large populations in hard-to-reach areas might not be reached by surveillance, which could be read as equity raised as a limitation.

notes: Claims compare indicators with fixed targets and between 2022 and 2023; framework set to fixed referent, though year-to-year pair contrasts (percent changes) are also prominent. 'ES site sensitivity' is surveillance sensitivity, not diagnostic accuracy, and the Table 2 'weighted mean percentage' is pooling arithmetic, not survey weighting. Genetic cluster classification is a lab step, not a procedure.
view_issues: Text gives AFR 2023 VDPV cases as 471 (133 cVDPV1, 338 cVDPV2), but Table 1 gives 492 (133, 359). Text says 15 (53.5%) of 28 countries; 15/28 is 53.6%.
